meaning: the entity is one span of custody on a material edge, who carries the carrier from one place to the next, cut wherever custody changes hands; or an empty move by a robot kept for its next segment
_notes: `owner` is `agent-studio`, who answers for this shape today; the registry moves ownership freely (world-proto server/DESIGN.md section 7). Lead decided, say if not.

The schema is open to fields it does not name, as every registry schema is (world-proto SPEC section 9's lenient reading), so a misspelt optional field passes WPS and is carried unread. Lead decided, say if not.

A reference field takes a declared or derived identity, bare or with any pin, as the core's references do (without their `local_ref`); the pin rule, enforced on world-proto master since c384e59, refuses a wrong pin in its own sentence, and `refs[].pin` says which pin each field takes. Lead decided, say if not.
An optional list, when present, holds at least one entry, so an empty list never says something different from an absent one. Lead decided, say if not.
An empty move (`carries: nothing`) has no `edge` and no `step`; every other segment has both ("always, except an empty move"). Lead decided, say if not.

Not in the schema, the flow compiler's to check: steps chaining from the edge's `from` node to its `to` node; a port the node's kind has; custody passing only at a handoff port; a `retained_for` segment starting where this one ends; a `conveyance` executor naming a conveyance node; `arrives` and `leaves` with an external executor.

schema.title: flow.agent_segment
schema.description: the entity is one span of custody on a material edge, who carries the carrier from one place to the next, cut wherever custody changes hands; or an empty move by a robot kept for its next segment
schema.$comment: Written for world-proto's registry from Agent Studio's 06-flow-panel-and-compiler.md section 3.1 (notes/agent-studio-2026-10-17/design/specs/06-flow-panel-and-compiler.md). Open to fields a newer writer adds (SPEC section 9).

edge.description: The material edge this span helps carry; absent on an empty move.

step.description: This span's place in its edge's chain, from 1.

at_end.description: What happens at `to`: custody passes at a handoff port to the next step's executor; the robot sets the carrier down at a port; the robot keeps the carrier through the work; or, for an external executor, the goods are there or the order leaves the site.

retained_for.description: Segments the same robot carries on with next instead of returning to the fleet; each starts where this one ends.

place.title: place
place.description: A node and one of its ports; the ports a node has follow its kind.

executor.title: executor
executor.description: Who carries: a named robot cohort; the cohort hard-assigned at the `from` or `to` place, named as a kind and resolved per member by the compiler; a conveyance node's belt; or nothing modelled.

reference.title: reference
reference.description: Another entity, by identity: a declared UUID or a derivation address, bare or with a pin. Which pin a field takes is the pin rule's to enforce: within the referrer's unit bare or `@head`, across units a changeset (a tag once tags land).

entity_id.title: entity id
entity_id.description: A declared entity's UUID or a derived entity's address, either arm (SPEC section 3).
